description:
Compile and execute a C# method body on the Unity Editor main thread. UnityEngine, UnityEditor, project/package types, and the typed Locus SDK are available. With enable_non_public_access enabled (default), access private/internal members directly without reflection. Common namespaces are included; qualify ambiguous type names.

Top-level await uses ExecuteAsync(..., ExecuteCodeContext ctx, CancellationToken cancellationToken) and can yield across frames. Use return null; for an early return.

Results: print(obj) adds text; printJson(obj) serializes stored data without invoking property getters or enumerating deferred/custom collections. Shared/cyclic references use $id/$ref; nested Unity references are compact descriptors. A single expression prints automatically; clear() resets output.

ctx.PropertyTree(target, depth, maxArrayItems) inspects the live tree; LocusPropertyTree.Format is the static equivalent. ctx.GetConsoleLog(level, limit) or ctx.GetConsoleLog(levels, limit) reads merged Console entries. await ctx.wait, WaitFrame/WaitFrames/WaitSeconds/WaitUntil yield to Editor updates; ctx.Progress reports progress to the Locus tool call panel; ClearProgress and CancellationToken support cleanup.

Use dedicated Unity Test tools for ordinary tests. Composite scripts with com.unity.test-framework may use UnityTestApi.ListAsync(query), UnityTestApi.Start(options), Status(runId), and Cancel(runId).

request_editor_status declares the required state; Locus applies configured state-change permissions, including when code explicitly changes status through EditorApplication play/pause APIs. Plan mode requires observation in the current state. Import non-script assets when needed; keep project script recompilation and .cs imports/changes outside this call because domain reload disconnects it.

code.description: C# code to compile and execute in Unity Editor. Written as the body of a static method. Use print(obj), printJson(obj), or ctx.PropertyTree(target, depth, maxArrayItems) to return results.

readonly.description: Whether the code only observes state. Use true only when it does not change Unity objects, assets, scenes, project settings, editor state, project files, or other filesystem content. Read-only calls are scheduled with read tools and skip workspace mutation locking and undo snapshots.

request_editor_status.description: Required Unity Editor status before running. If the current status must change, or the code explicitly changes status through EditorApplication play/pause APIs, Locus applies the Unity status-change permission before continuing.

enable_non_public_access.description: Allow this call to directly access private and internal types, APIs, and fields without reflection. Defaults to true and is also governed by the global Hot Reload & Compile setting.
